title: Area-weighted mesh surface scatter
purpose: Scatter points uniformly over any triangle mesh or BufferGeometry: triangles picked by area with a Vose alias table, uniform barycentric placement, optional per-vertex density, interpolated normals and matrices that stand models on the surface. Use it for grass, spikes, moss and debris on meshes.

engine.name: node
engine.notes: No three.js needed: it reads typed arrays or a BufferGeometry's attribute arrays and returns typed arrays. The demo was rendered with three.js 0.186.1 in headless Chrome.

exports.name: scatterOnSurface
exports.signature: scatterOnSurface(positions, indices = null, options = {}) -> {positions, normals, triangles, barycentrics}
exports.summary: count points uniform by area or by interpolated per-vertex weight, with unit normals, triangle ids and barycentrics.

exports.name: scatterOnGeometry
exports.summary: The same on a BufferGeometry's position, index and normal attributes.

exports.name: surfaceMatrices
exports.summary: Matrices with model +Y along each normal, seeded spin and scale, lifted by an offset.

exports.name: buildAliasTable
exports.summary: Vose's alias table for constant-time weighted sampling.

exports.name: sampleAlias
exports.summary: One draw from an alias table with two uniform numbers in [0, 1).

options.name: weights
options.meaning: Relative density at each vertex, interpolated across triangles by rejection.

options.name: normals
options.meaning: Normals to interpolate; null uses face normals (scatterOnGeometry reads the normal attribute).

options.name: scaleJitter
options.meaning: surfaceMatrices: scale varies by up to this fraction either way.

options.name: spin
options.meaning: surfaceMatrices: seeded spin about the normal.

limits: Samples are independent: points can land very close together (no minimum spacing; use Poisson disk scatter for that on flat ground). Per-vertex weights are interpolated linearly across each triangle, so density follows the mesh resolution. Skinned or morph-animated meshes are sampled in their rest pose. Interleaved attributes are copied out first. Matrices stand models along the normal with uniform scale; no tangent alignment. Only three.js 0.186.1 was run for the demo, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2.
technique_references: Uniform barycentric sampling with the square-root of a uniform number
Rejection sampling against a per-triangle envelope for per-vertex density
Shortest-arc quaternion from +Y to a normal
